question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.

There are a number of artists currently creating unique, collectble teapots.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"collectble"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"collectible"**, which means something worth collecting, often due to being rare or valuable. (संग्रहणीय)

 
 
• **Example: **Many people consider vintage stamps to be highly **collectible.**
 
 
 
• **"Collectible"** refers to an item that is worth collecting due to its rarity, value, or appeal. (संग्रहणीय)
 
 
• **Example: **Rare coins are often considered** collectible** items by enthusiasts.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Currantly** (वर्तमान में): Incorrect spelling of "currently".

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He is currantly working on a new project.
 
 
 
• **Currintly** (वर्तमान में): Incorrect spelling of "currently".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is currintly studying for her exams.
 
 
 
• **Collectable** (संग्रहणीय): An alternative but less common spelling of "collectible".
 
 
• **Example:** Some people use the term collectable to refer to rare items.
 
 
 
• **Collectibile** (संग्रहणीय): Incorrect spelling of "collectible".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Many toys from the 1980s are now considered collectibile.
 
 

42:Tbaa,
The correct answer is **Option 4**
